_comment: The nine skills, and which statue manages their perks.
WHY THIS IS PINNED. The Skills page lists its nine skills inside a prose
sentence and then repeats them as `=== Heading ===` sections — but so does
`=== Skill Perks ===`, which is not a skill. Rather than heuristically
deciding which level-3 headings are skills, the parser is handed the list and
scopes to exactly those sections. A tenth skill in a future patch is then a
one-line edit here plus a warning from the enricher, not a silent omission.
STATUE. Perks for seven skills are bought at Caldarus' Shrine on the farm;
Mining and Combat are bought at the Dragon Statue in the mines. Stated on the
Skills page ('Speak with ... to manage'). It matters to the app because the
two statues unlock at different points in the game.
MAX LEVEL. The page says 60 levels for every skill, stamped v0-15-0. The XP
curve is NOT on the wiki in any form — it stays null with an `xp_curve` data
gap until the game files land at G1. A plausible curve would be indis-
tinguishable from a real one, which is exactly the failure this project
refuses to ship.
PERK DESCRIPTIONS ARE NOT CAPTURED. The Description column of every perk
table is verbatim in-game text. The parser reads the perk name, tier, level
and Essence cost — all factual numbers — and never the description. See
docs/DATA-POLICY.md; `effect_key` stays null until game files give us a
symbolic key rather than a sentence.
